Overview

AI Ads, explained

Advertising platforms have changed. Google and Meta now use AI to decide who sees your ads, where they appear and how much to bid. Set up well, this can find customers you'd never have targeted manually. Set up poorly, it spends money on the wrong people.

AI Ads is our managed service for these AI-driven campaign types. We give the platforms strong creative, accurate conversion data and the right audience signals, then review results every week so the AI works towards enquiries and sales, not just clicks.

Who it's for

  • Businesses already advertising on Google or Meta
  • eCommerce stores with many products
  • Businesses wanting to test more ad creative
  • All-in-One plan clients

Why it matters

Why AI Ads matters for your business

Google's Performance Max and Meta's Advantage+ campaigns use AI to decide who sees your ads, where and when. They can find customers you'd never have targeted by hand.

The AI is only as good as what you give it. Weak creative, poor tracking or the wrong goals lead it to optimise for the wrong things, often cheap clicks that never convert.

We provide the inputs that matter: strong, varied creative, accurate conversion data and audience signals. Then we review results regularly so people stay in charge of the strategy.

FAQ

AI Ads questions

How is AI Ads different from normal Google & Meta Ads?

AI Ads uses the platforms' automated campaign types, which decide audiences, placements and bids. We focus on giving the AI good inputs and checking its results.

Is AI Ads included in a plan?

Yes. AI Ads is part of the All-in-One plan, or can be added on its own.

Does AI Ads cost more than normal ads?

Our management fee is quoted in writing, and ad spend is always shown separately.

Can AI Ads damage our brand?

We set brand guardrails, review creative and exclude placements that don't suit you.

How soon do AI campaigns work well?

The platforms need time and conversion data to learn. We'll set expectations in your plan.

Do AI campaigns replace normal campaigns?

Often they work alongside them. We recommend the right mix for your goals.

Can we see which audiences the AI found?

Platforms share some insights, and we explain what we can see in your report.

Is AI Ads good for small budgets?

It can be, but the AI needs enough conversion data to learn. We'll advise in your plan.
